cards.mood: The piece opens with an ethereal and floating atmosphere, establishing a sense of vastness and introspection.
cards.vocal: A single female vocalist delivers the performance with a soft, breathy, and crystalline timbre.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing patterns in the velvet night
Watching the city glow in gold
The roof is high, the air is still
Dreams are waiting for the moon to fill
[Pre-Chorus]
Lost in the space between heartbeats
Floating where the earth and sky meet
[Chorus]
Drifting through a sea of stars
Washing over me like velvet rain
A universe inside a single breath
Finding home in every silver trace
[Verse]
Shadows dance upon the bedroom wall
Time is moving slow and sweet
A distant whisper in the cooling breeze
Finding pieces of a hidden peace
[Pre-Chorus]
Lost in the space between heartbeats
Floating where the earth and sky meet
[Chorus]
Drifting through a sea of stars
Washing over me like velvet rain
A universe inside a single breath
Finding home in every silver trace
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Gravity pulls but the spirit flies
Chasing the light in the cosmic skies
[Chorus]
Drifting through a sea of stars
Washing over me like velvet rain
A universe inside a single breath
Finding home in every silver trace
[Outro]
